# SD18 deterministic Human Ranger level 20 fifth Favored Enemy / Master
# Hunter widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic Human Ranger level-1..level-19
# hybrid chassis (tests/sd18_ranger_level19_widening.rs, the loop's most
# recent Ranger ceiling) to Ranger level 20 as chosen input only. It names
# selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity values. It
# is the level-19 fixture with the class level bumped, plus two new choice
# slots: the fifth favored-enemy TYPE selection (choice:ranger_favored_
# enemy_5, PF1 Core Rulebook: "At 5th level and every five levels
# thereafter (10th, 15th, and 20th level), the ranger may select an
# additional favored enemy") and this 20th-level interval's own
# bonus-increase TARGET choice
# (choice:ranger_favored_enemy_bonus_increase_target_4, restricted to the
# now-five-enemy set), targeting the SECOND favored enemy this time (a
# deliberately different target than the 5th/15th-level intervals'
# "first"/"fourth" targets already in the level-19 fixture, so the
# second favored enemy's own magnitude genuinely rises at level 20 while
# the first and fourth stay unchanged -- a real, checked test case, not
# an assumption). The 20th-level "Special" column's other entry, "master
# hunter" (verified independently against d20pfsrd and the Archives of
# Nethys aonprd.com mirror, both byte-for-byte identical), is a brand-new
# capstone ability with no player choice involved, so it needs no new
# choice slot -- it is grounded purely from the class-level gate.
#
# Everything else carries over from the level-19 fixture unchanged. No
# action-economy engine, no attack-resolution engine, and no
# saving-throw-resolution engine exists in this codebase, so Master
# Hunter's own standard-action attack/Fortitude-save-or-die ability is
# never applied to any actual roll; the fixture makes no such claim.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-ranger-level20-sd18-fifth-favored-enemy-and-master-hunter
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:ranger:20
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:14
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:8
feat=feat:power_attack
skill=skill:survival:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:strength
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy:enemy:humanoid_orc
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy_2:enemy:undead
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy_bonus_increase_target:enemy:first
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy_4:enemy:construct
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy_bonus_increase_target_3:enemy:fourth
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy_5:enemy:dragon
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy_bonus_increase_target_4:enemy:second
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style:style:archery

choice=choice:ranger_hunters_bond:form:bond
